about.title: About Us
about.heading: Fresh Fruit By Ruth
about.paragraph1: At Fresh Fruit By Ruth, we specialize in creating beautiful, fresh fruit arrangements and specialty items. From large fruit trays perfect for events to individual fruit cups and refreshing beverages, we bring the best of fresh fruit to your table.
about.paragraph2: Whether you're hosting a community event, school function, wellness gathering, or fundraiser, we provide customizable options to meet your needs. All our items are made fresh with quality ingredients and can accommodate various dietary preferences.
